title: run_shell_command integration tests are borked
body:
### What happened?

These tests are totally broken, they aren't passing the arguments they think they are passing (due to existing static errors), yolo mode is enabled making them totally irrelevant, and they also pass even if the tool calls do fail.

They need a big overhaul.

### What did you expect to happen?

They should actually validate the behavior they intend to.

linked_prs.title: fix integration test static errors, and run_shell_command tests to actually be testing what they intend
linked_prs.body:
## TLDR

Cleans up all static errors in the integration_tests directory, especially cleaning up the very real problems with the run_shell_command tests.

Also added an option to disable yolo mode in `rig.run`.

## Dive Deeper

We should separately consider dropping the default yolo mode behavior of `rig.run` as I think this is harmful as evidenced by these test issues.
